cohort: The study included 1550 breastfeeding mothers of infants up to 2 years old, recruited through social media platforms in Finland and the UK.
finding: Breastfeeding stress directly increased parenting stress and role strain, while social support directly reduced them, with social support showing no moderating effect on the relationship between breastfeeding and parenting stress.
cross-section timing: mothers of infants up to 2 years old
